content:
With only weeks to go until the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Fold launch, Apple is in the final stages of preparation behind the scenes. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple is holding a lottery among its U.S. retail store employees to select lucky winners to travel to California and assist with the iPhone launch event in September.

iPhone launch event scheduled for September

The report states that Apple Store retail employees can apply to take part in this iPhone launch event, with duties including "helping maintain orderly queues, checking in attendees, greeting guests, providing directions, and supporting the security team."

Apple announced the lottery arrangement in an internal memo, stating that the event will be held in the first half of September.

In the memo, Apple said it was "excited to offer U.S. store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience programme." For years, Apple has relied on retail store employees to help coordinate major product launches. Employees who took part in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) or last year's iPhone launch event are not eligible to apply for this programme. According to the memo, interested employees must submit their applications by 8 August, and Apple will notify the selected candidates on 17 August.

Apple has historically held its annual iPhone launch event in the second week of September. With U.S. Labor Day falling on 7 September this year, Bloomberg noted that "a Wednesday is slightly more likely, as this preserves the workday travel time Apple has traditionally provided for attendees."

If held as scheduled, the iPhone launch event will take place on Wednesday, 9 September, with pre-orders expected to open that Friday and the product going on sale one week later.
